_comment: Data-driven regression cases for the FBR Rules corpus. status: 'active' = must pass; 'known_gap' = tracked but not counted as a regression; 'needs_review' = subjective QA note. applies_to is a substring of metadata.filename. Add cases with add_test_case.py or by hand. NOTE: CI cannot run these -- it has no private corpus and tools/run_tests_smoke.py is an import smoke test -- so `python tools/rules/run_tests.py` against data/corpora/rules/ is a required local step before merging a pipeline change.

cases.description: Rule 78: the heading terminator is a DOUBLE hyphen ('...and period. -- Where any rule ...'). It must split there, so the first body line survives into the html; a single-hyphen-only test dropped 'Where any rule specifies any time or'.
cases.arg: Where any rule specifies any time or period

cases.description: Footnote 25.35: 'w.e.f. 1st day of July, 2008' -- the raised ordinal must re-attach. The suffix is a 5.04pt superscript 2.22pt away from its digit, outside the Acts-calibrated gap bound.
Footnote 14: the 'th' of '24th March' is drawn at FULL body size, merely raised, and sorts onto the footnote MARKER's line -- it used to survive as a bare '14.^cont' footnote reading only 'th'.

Chapter XIV-A is printed '[CHAPTER XIV-A' with the amendment-insertion bracket. 15 of the 40 chapters carry it; anchoring hard on the keyword left them unclassified, their rows glued into the previous section's heading and their rules parented to the wrong chapter. The expected heading reads OROTHER, not OR OTHER: the caption is set over three lines and pdfplumber returns the third as the single token 'OROTHER' (x0=238.8, x1=310.6, no space in the text layer). That is this document's documented no_jammed_words cause, which it carries an exemption for; asserting the de-jammed string made this case fail on a defect it does not test. What it tests is that the bracketed chapter row is CLASSIFIED, and it still fails if that regresses.
cases.arg: MONITORING OR TRACKING OF CERTAIN REGISTERED PERSONS BY ELECTRONIC OROTHER MEANS

cases.description: Rule 150ZQT's heading must not absorb the TOC's 'SUB-CHAPTER 2 126 APPROVAL OF THE VENDOR 126' row. Sales Tax Rules is the only document here with a sub-chapter level; the tree does not model it, so the row is consumed.
cases.arg: Goods to be monitored electronically through video cameras etc

cases.description: KNOWN GAP -- Customs Rules 2001 is not one instrument: 563 pages bind 44 separate S.R.O. rule-sets (Baggage, Auction, Frustrated Cargo, ATA Carnet ...) behind a roman-numeral 'Chapter Contents' index and a MEMORANDUM table. The tree models one instrument, so it comes out as 1 chapter / 62 sections whose codes are the MEMORANDUM's S.No. column. Supporting compilations is a document-class feature, not a parser fix; until then this edition should not be in output/. Tracked by section_codes_ordered (32 failures).

Rule 58U opens '111[58U]. Application:--' -- S.R.O. 188(I)/2015 RENAMED rule 59, so the amendment bracket wraps the code alone and the dot prints after the ']'. _DOTFORM_RE wants the dot where the ']' is, so the rule bound to nothing and its body (with 58V's) was carried onto 58W.
cases.arg: manufacturers of goods specified against S. No. 13
cases.applies_to: SALES TAX SPECIAL PROCEDURES RULES,, 2007 UPDATED UPTO 05.03.2015
